settings.propagationNote: Changes flush the snapshot cache immediately; downstream consumers (HLS, scheduler, intro detection) pick them up on their next read. Avatar storage directory is the lone exception — it lazy-caches at startup, so changes require a restart and a manual move of existing files.

errors.minLessThanMax: Min must be less than max.

scheduler.title: Scheduler
scheduler.summary: Master switch for every periodic job.
scheduler.subtitle: Master switch for every periodic job (library scans, thumbnail backfill, intro detection). Off here means no job ticks at all, regardless of its per-job switch.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.helper: Off disables the entire scheduler. Per-job switches below still apply when this is on.

reconcile.label: Reconcile interval
reconcile.helper: How often APScheduler re-reads library schedules from the database. Lower picks up edits sooner; higher reduces idle DB chatter.

thumbnailBackfill.title: Thumbnail backfill
thumbnailBackfill.summary: Generates scrub-preview sprites in the background.
thumbnailBackfill.subtitle: Periodic job that fills in scrub-preview sprites for items the operator hasn't streamed yet.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.helper: Toggle the backfill loop. The scheduler master switch must also be on for this to tick.

cadence.label: Cadence
cadence.helper: Lower batch size smooths CPU spikes; higher catches up faster on a fresh catalog.

subdir.label: Subdirectory
subdir.helper: Path (relative to each media file's parent folder) where sprite + VTT pairs are written.

artworkMirror.title: Artwork mirror
artworkMirror.summary: Mirrors provider artwork to local storage.
artworkMirror.subtitle: Periodic job that downloads still-remote poster / backdrop / logo / still images and stores them locally, so the catalog stops depending on the provider CDN.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.helper: Toggle the mirror loop. The scheduler master switch must also be on for this to tick.

cadence.label: Cadence
cadence.helper: Lower batch size spreads network + disk load; higher catches up faster on a large catalog.

maxSize.label: Maximum image size
maxSize.helper: Larger downloads are skipped and keep their remote URL for a later retry.

storage.label: Storage location
storage.helper: Mirrored images are stored on the server as flat <hash>.<ext> files. The directory is set at startup via the ARTWORK_STORAGE_DIRECTORY environment variable; changing it requires a restart.

introDetection.title: Intro detection
introDetection.summary: Detects intros to offer Skip Intro.
introDetection.subtitle: Detects series intros so the player can offer Skip Intro. Pick the algorithm below — both run on the server (Chromaprint also needs the fpcalc binary on PATH).

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.helper: Toggle the detection loop. The scheduler master switch must also be on for this to tick.

algorithm.label: Algorithm
algorithm.helper: Frame-hash (video) recovers intros regardless of a variable-length cold open, but decodes video. Chromaprint (audio) is lighter but blind to intros whose audio theme varies.

cadence.label: Cadence
cadence.helper: Each season analyses every episode, so values above 2 can saturate the host on large seasons.

analysisWindow.label: Analysis window
analysisWindow.helper: Leading media analysed per episode. 600 s covers long cold-opens plus the title sequence; trim lower to speed up at the cost of missing late intros.

confidence.label: Confidence
confidence.helper: Minimum share of peer episodes that must agree before a marker is persisted.

chromaprint.label: Chromaprint tuning
chromaprint.helper: Audio-detector calibration. Tune cautiously — calibrated against real-world detections.

frameHash.label: Frame-hash tuning
frameHash.helper: Video-detector calibration. A stricter hash distance means fewer false matches; calibrated against real-world detections.

bounds.label: Length bounds
bounds.helper: Detections outside this range are dropped (too short = stinger, too long = shared footage bleeding past the title).

creditsDetection.title: Credits detection
creditsDetection.subtitle: Per-file end-credits detection (mark-watched, auto-next, skip). Combines edge/text density and low-motion signals — best-effort and content-dependent; correct misses with the manual editor.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.helper: Run the periodic per-file credits-detection job. Requires ffmpeg + ffprobe on the host.

cadence.label: Cadence
cadence.helper: How many files each tick analyses and how often the job runs.

sampling.label: Sampling
sampling.helper: How much of each file's trailing window to analyse, and how densely to sample it.

confidence.label: Confidence & minimum length
confidence.helper: Minimum detector confidence before a marker is saved, and the shortest run that counts as credits.

thresholds.label: Signal thresholds
thresholds.helper: Edge factor (× the window median above which a frame is text-heavy) and motion factor (fraction of the median below which a frame is low-activity).

subtitleOcr.title: Subtitle OCR
subtitleOcr.subtitle: OCR image-based (PGS/SUP) subtitles into selectable text — the fix for Blu-ray remuxes whose only subtitles are bitmaps. Off by default; requires ffmpeg + tesseract (with the relevant language data) on the host. Best-effort — quality varies by source.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.helper: Run the periodic job that OCRs image subtitles to text WebVTT sidecars. Requires tesseract on the host.

cadence.label: Cadence
cadence.helper: How many files each tick OCRs and how often the job runs. OCR is expensive — keep the batch small.

languages.label: Languages
languages.helper: Which subtitle languages to OCR. Leave empty to OCR every track whose language has an installed tesseract model.
languages.hint: Comma-separated ISO 639-1 codes (e.g. en, pt). Empty = all installed.

engine.label: Engine
engine.helper: The tesseract executable and the timeout for a single subtitle cue.

streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.subtitle: ffmpeg parallelism cap + HLS cache ceiling. Applies to HLS transcoding, subtitle extraction, and scrub-preview sprite generation.

hwAccel.label: Hardware acceleration
hwAccel.helper: Video encoder for HLS transcoding and scrub-preview sprites. Auto uses NVIDIA NVENC when a working GPU encoder is detected and falls back to software — decisive for 4K/HEVC, which otherwise saturates the CPU. Has no effect on already-H.264 sources, which are remuxed, not re-encoded.

threads.label: ffmpeg threads
threads.helper: Caps worker threads per ffmpeg invocation. Off leaves ffmpeg in auto (uses every logical core). Set to roughly cpu_count / 2 to cap transcoding to ~50 % of the host. Caps parallelism, not absolute CPU — use cgroups or equivalent for a hard limit.

cacheCap.label: HLS cache cap
cacheCap.helper: Maximum cache directory size. The LRU evictor drops least-recently-accessed buckets once usage exceeds this. Bump on large catalogs to avoid re-transcoding popular titles.
cacheCap.unlimited: 0 disables eviction — cache grows without bound.

avatar.title: Profile avatars
avatar.subtitle: Output location and sizing for uploaded profile avatars.

storageSubdir.label: Storage subdirectory
storageSubdir.helper: Path (relative to the thumbnails directory) where uploaded WebP avatars are written. Lazy-cached at startup.

sizing.label: Sizing
sizing.helper: Max upload size + final square side length after resize. 256 px is the size the picker renders at 1×; bumping it lets the picker render crisper at 2× / 3×.

avatar.subdirMigrationWarning: Changing the storage subdirectory requires an app restart and a manual move of existing avatar files. The path takes effect for new uploads only.

scanDedup.title: Scan deduplication
scanDedup.subtitle: Runtime-delta thresholds for the post-enrich conflict detector. A duplicate is flagged as a suspected different edit only when its runtime delta exceeds BOTH bounds.

thresholds.label: Different-edit thresholds
thresholds.helper: A pair whose runtime delta stays within either bound is treated as the same release. Both must be exceeded to suggest a Director's Cut / Theatrical split.

fallback.label: Title + year fallback
fallback.helper: When on, also flags duplicates by normalized original title + year — catching entries whose enrichment never locked a TMDB id. These weaker matches always go to the queue and are never auto-merged.

sweep.label: Scheduled sweep
sweep.helper: When on, a background job walks the whole catalog on the configured interval and re-runs the detector — catches duplicates that landed after the original enrich and pairs that never matched TMDB.

conflicts.title: Content conflicts
conflicts.subtitle: Pairs of titles flagged as the same content by the post-enrich detector. Resolve each one as intentionally distinct, replace, or merge keeping both files as variants.

dialog.title: Mark conflicts as distinct
dialog.body: Mark the {{count}} selected conflicts as intentionally distinct?
dialog.consequence1: The detector won't re-queue these pairs on future enrichment passes.
dialog.consequence2: No movies are deleted — both titles in each pair stay in the catalog.

dialog.title: Run catalog dedup sweep?
dialog.body: Re-runs the conflict detector against every movie in the catalog. Useful for catching duplicates the event-driven detector missed.
dialog.consequence1: No movies are re-enriched and nothing is auto-merged — pairs only land in the queue.
dialog.consequence2: Large catalogs may take a moment. The queue refreshes once the sweep finishes.

empty.title: No pending conflicts
empty.subtitle: Every detected duplicate has been resolved or none has been flagged yet.
empty.auditTitle: Nothing in the audit log yet
empty.auditSubtitle: Resolved entries appear here once the operator (or the auto-merge detector) closes them.

dialog.title: Resolve conflict
dialog.body: Pick the disposition for this pair. Merge actions soft-delete the losing movie and update cross-context references; mark-as-distinct is a no-op for the data itself.
dialog.irreversibleWarning: Merge actions soft-delete the loser and cannot be undone from this UI.

mark_distinct.description: The pair is intentionally different; the detector won't re-queue it.

merge_replace.description: Keep the winner only; the loser is soft-deleted and its file variants are desreferenced.

merge_keep_both.description: Transfer the loser's file variants to the winner before soft-deleting; the player can pick the best stream at playback time.
